actions.name: petrifying gaze
actions.desc: When a creature that can see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s eyes starts its turn within [[lookup @target.template.size activity=LoXmK0mBZ0hatvaU]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can force it to make a [[/save activity=LoXmK0mBZ0hatvaU]] saving throw if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} isn't &reference[incapacitated apply=false] and can see the creature. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly &reference[petrified]. Otherwise, a creature that fails the save begins to turn to stone and is &reference[restrained]. The restrained creature must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn, becoming &reference[petrified] on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.WzvJ7G3cqvIubsLk]{greater restoration} spell or other magic. Unless &reference[surprise]{Surprised}, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} in the meantime, it must immediately make the save. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} sees itself reflected on a polished surface within 30 feet of it and in an area of &reference[bright light], the medusa is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The medusa makes either three melee attacks - one with its [[/item .1N53jrQmsZuhiREF]]{snake hair} and two with its [[/item .ixrzcEmkn9jaDOZ0]]{shortsword} - or two ranged attacks with its [[/item .4U98oe3Qr28BGbzG]]{longbow}.
